lines: When concept impresses in order for entry
into the nature just told — then the contemplation
sequence, preceded by true reason, true scripture
and true teacher's instruction, has its use.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tatra yadā vikalpaṃ krameṇa saṃskurute samanantaroktasvarūpapraveśāya tadā bhāvanākramasya sattarkasadāgamasadgurūpadeśapūrvakasya asti upayogaḥ
